decision_rationale: Structure, scope, input boundaries, symmetry and fail-closed rules are proposal-ready. Numeric mapping, counting/terminal semantics, historical source closure and independent approval remain unsupported; neither complete approval readiness nor activation is claimed.

authority.owner: HSI paired-research policy governance; future deterministic read-only resolver consuming canonical sources

scope.purpose: One common future comparison horizon for incumbent continuation versus challenger in an authentic Gate1 paired rotation research event.
scope.source_event: Original ROTATE_IN-compatible paired event under predecessor origin contract, never an action emitted here.
scope.instrument_scope: Propose exact-source NSE cash-equity identities for both legs; actual supported strategy/instrument/state combinations remain empty until mapping approval. NseEquityInstrument defaults are not proof.

evidence_basis: Repository-only pinned audit; no new DB capture, external acquisition, empirical study, outcome computation or calibration. A proposal cannot retroactively make post-D policy approval visible at D.

input_admission.purpose: Freeze original D and pair; never current review time or generated event.
input_admission.admission: Archive/replay event is authentic under predecessor; exact original comparison/pair/source closure.
input_admission.pit_replay: Original event and source references verified at D; later replay metadata is administrative only.

input_admission.fields: NseEquityInstrument.instrument_id / isin / security_type / exchange / data_as_of / provenance_reference
input_admission.purpose: Confirm exact canonical identities and a supported instrument/venue/state scope.
input_admission.admission: Both legs have original D-visible identity/type/listing lineage; dataclass defaults are not source proof.
input_admission.pit_replay: Historical master/membership/source version closure required; no today-membership, fuzzy symbol or default EQUITY inference.

input_admission.purpose: Exact original strategy ID/version/fingerprint and applicability context; not duration authority.
input_admission.admission: Use native verification/approval/selection at D. For Pre-Breakout, exact CURRENT_VALID_SETUP routing and policy path still required.
input_admission.pit_replay: No current lookup or claim that other archetypes have executable policies. Horizon policy is independently approved.

input_admission.purpose: Verify existing originating archetype, setup routes and evidence, not assign a numeric horizon.
input_admission.admission: Exact original Watch/run linkage and full input closure known at D; pure router expects evidence already PIT filtered.
input_admission.pit_replay: Router output alone lacks its own cutoff/known-at envelope. Do not rerun with current data or call latest() without explicit D.

input_admission.purpose: Carry a unique already-declared category, never infer it from an archetype name.
input_admission.admission: Exact lead.verify(), source/funnel version, instrument and original event linkage; every lineage known_at <= D; discovery_as_of <= D.
input_admission.pit_replay: One distinct category required in proposed first scope. A lead existing today does not establish original decision-time availability.

input_admission.purpose: Verify exact originating setup type/policy, not price or time-stop inputs.
input_admission.admission: Retained canonical setup and its approval/selection closure at D; no new setup calculation.
input_admission.pit_replay: time_horizon_status remains NOT_GOVERNED_FOR_SETUP_OPPORTUNITY; no duration implied.

input_admission.fields: Original evaluation/comparison IDs and frozen pair references
input_admission.purpose: Bind the authentic research pair only.
input_admission.admission: Consume already-frozen predecessor origin envelope; do not read current portfolio, allocations or holdings.
input_admission.pit_replay: Elapsed holding, cash, average holding period and review schedule cannot select duration.

input_admission.fields: Canonical stored macro/market evidence references, if original and PIT-verifiable
input_admission.purpose: Preserve optional original context, not a regime-conditioned duration.
input_admission.admission: Do not admit descriptive text/AI inference as an authoritative routing field.
input_admission.pit_replay: An adaptive regime-to-duration policy has no approved mapping; not included in first proposal's selector.

input_admission.admission: No free-text lag or current sector ranking can override original category.
input_admission.pit_replay: Typed/canonical source closure is necessary for trace; no sector-dependent horizon mapping approved.

input_admission.purpose: Preserve FACT/DATA/INTERPRETATION/INFERENCE boundaries and original references only.
input_admission.admission: No expected lag, narrative, freshness or priced-in inference selects duration.
input_admission.pit_replay: Future event realization and retrospective impact are forbidden selection inputs; event-specific numeric policy deferred.

input_admission.fields: SHORT_TERM diagnostic candidate versus tactical product prose
input_admission.purpose: Audit vocabulary without inventing a new category or synonym.
input_admission.admission: No supported DiscoveryHorizon.SHORT_TERM/TACTICAL route currently exists.
input_admission.pit_replay: B09 candidate is not active; no tactical-to-short-term or bar-timeframe-to-duration conversion.

input_admission.fields: OutcomeSample.horizon and other unrelated windows identified by predecessor audit
input_admission.admission: Reject paper expiry, actual holding duration, outcome windows, unverified strings, self-hashes and AI/user arbitrary values.
input_admission.pit_replay: No future label, best return, later calibration or runtime time may affect D's choice.

categories.semantics: Existing positional inspection/routing context; no economic duration.
categories.native_uses: Pre-Breakout and sector adapters emit this category. Inflection and policy-transmission adapters may emit it alongside LONG_TERM.
categories.supported_strategy_mapping: UNSET; actual mapping rows must name exact supported strategy/archetype/policy refs. Native funnel membership does not activate those strategies.
categories.at_D: Conditional on original lead and full source closure; no retrospective reconstruction.

categories.semantics: Existing long-term business/research inspection context; no common numeric wealth period.
categories.native_uses: Compounder adapter emits this category. Inflection and policy-transmission adapters may also emit POSITIONAL.
categories.supported_strategy_mapping: UNSET; no long-term family becomes a positive or executable policy through this category.
categories.at_D: Conditional on original lead and full source closure; business outcome maturity cannot backfill D.

categories.semantics: Existing diagnostic context vocabulary, not an available discovery-lead category or tactical-duration synonym.
categories.native_uses: Radar maps only the existing POSITIONAL and LONG_TERM DiscoveryHorizon values; applicability remains POLICY_UNSET.
categories.at_D: Diagnostic context/candidate document is insufficient authority.

routing_contract.source_verification: Native contract and raw fingerprint verification plus independent original-event linkage and known-at closure required. Do not recreate or repair a source. Source hashes carry their native scheme, not a forced replacement hash.

row_shape.row_id: unique row identity within mapping version
row_shape.category: POSITIONAL | LONG_TERM, exact canonical origin reference mandatory
row_shape.category_source_contract_ref: nonempty verified source contract ID/version/fingerprint scheme
row_shape.supported_strategy_refs: nonempty ordered exact ID/version/fingerprint references; no wildcard or placeholder executable policy
row_shape.supported_archetypes: nonempty ordered exact current OpportunityArchetype values
row_shape.supported_instrument_state_refs: nonempty ordered canonical applicability references for both legs
row_shape.numeric_duration: null in proposal; positive integer only if TRADING_SESSIONS becomes approved, never a default
row_shape.unit: null until independently approved; conceptual preference TRADING_SESSIONS is not an effective unit
row_shape.counting_rule_ref: null until independently approved; defines first-counted session and partial/special session treatment
row_shape.terminal_rule_ref: null until independently approved; defines phase/boundary and non-tradable exceptions
row_shape.precision_rule_ref: null until independently approved; exact timezone-aware instant representation
row_shape.justification_refs: ordered original methodological/empirical sources with identity/fingerprint and known-at
row_shape.approval_ref: null until independent human policy approval; includes scope and approving authority
row_shape.selection_ref: null until exact historical selection independently verified
row_shape.effective_version: null until approved version is selected; must equal exact mapping_version when resolved
row_shape.effectivity_verifier_ref: null until exact native approval/selection validity semantics are established
row_shape.activation_status: NOT_ACTIVE here; future activation requires separate authorized successor
row_shape.supersedes_ref: optional exact immutable prior version reference; no overwrite
row_shape.fingerprint: content fingerprint of complete normalized row excluding only fingerprint; self-hash is not approval

mapping.validation: Closed rows with explicit source schemes; no unknown fields, null/default-to-zero conversion, boolean-as-number, duplicate/conflicting row identity, wildcard scope or arbitrary priority. A proposal row is never effective. Future active mapping requires independently verified scope, approval, validity and unique selection at D.
mapping.selection: Exact category + original strategy/policy/archetype + both instrument/state scopes; zero rows unavailable, multiple distinct applicable rows conflicting. Do not choose first, latest-now or greatest return.
mapping.duplicate_rule: Retained identical source aliases counted once per predecessor semantics; same ID/version with different payload fails closed before any category collapse.

duration_units.basis: Both comparable market outcomes require canonical session/phase evidence; factual calendar already distinguishes trading and non-trading days.
duration_units.missing: No approved number, first-counted-session rule, partial/special-session weight, terminal phase or instrument-exception rule.

duration_units.basis: Represents elapsed calendar dates, including non-trading days; not equivalent to market opportunity.
duration_units.missing: Would need separate strategy justification and explicit tradable-terminal rule; cannot borrow cooldown days.

duration_units.basis: Represents elapsed time, not trading-session exposure.
duration_units.missing: Would require independent rationale, timezone/precision and terminal market alignment; no simple timedeltas or nearest-price default.

selection.all_decision_source_times: event/known/approval/selection <= D as appropriate under native source semantics
selection.effective_rule: Exact independently verified native policy validity intervals; no new universal effective-to convention.

terminal_proposal.executable_price_alignment: Separate D-visible capital/price methodology remains required; missing alignment is a blocker, never a later start/fill.
terminal_proposal.symbolic_rule: If a future approved mapping supplies N TRADING_SESSIONS and an approved counting/terminal policy, form the unique ordered eligible terminal sequence from D-visible canonical calendar/phase evidence under that policy; end is its Nth terminal. This is conditional structure, not an approved N, first counted session, phase or runtime algorithm.

cases.proposal: Use exact selected phase/precision and frozen approved count convention; missing rule prevents resolution.
Not a trading session in a future session-count policy; exact first-party D-visible schedule required. No calendar-day duration silently rolled.
Use source-derived weekday and special-day resolution, not hard-coded Monday-Friday arithmetic.
Use exact first-party day/phase; whether/how counted remains POLICY_REQUIRED. No unit weight or normal close invented.
Exchange session does not prove security tradability. Freeze common end; retain missing exact instrument outcome as unavailable/excluded.
No nearest later/prior bar, carry-forward or zero return. No complete label.
Require governed terminal entitlement/value and canonical identity lineage under predecessor wealth methodology, otherwise excluded without dropping the originating event.
Preserve horizon; require canonical comparable parcel/adjustment lineage for each leg, no endpoint change.
Later unexpected closure cannot rewrite frozen D-selected endpoint. Missing completion remains unresolved/pending or excluded; no data-driven extension.

calendar.missing: Economic N-session counting and terminal conventions, plus exact historical/calendar/instrument source coverage.
calendar.provenance: calendar_id + calendar fingerprint + contract version + original source IDs/fingerprints; no invented mutable calendar version.
calendar.visibility: Existing _source_visible: known_at first, otherwise exact published_at, otherwise published_on strictly before D's local date. Do not backfill exact intraday publication.
calendar.effectivity: Existing calendar date range semantics inclusive at both defined ends; not imported as unrelated horizon-policy approval interval semantics.

binding.reuse: Preserve predecessor PolicyRef/SourceRef/HorizonBinding/DecisionSnapshot wire contracts. Any future extra routing/mapping representation needs a new versioned wrapper; no mutation of old fingerprint inputs.
binding.fingerprint: Use existing canonical_json/content_fingerprint on complete normalized versioned content, exclude only own fingerprint; verify native inputs before normalization. Exact future wrapper schema/identity requires separate approval; no circular identity/fingerprint or omitted semantic field.
binding.identity: Existing paired observation identity remains unchanged. New wrapper identity, if needed later, must bind original event/pair/D and pinned policy/mapping/source versions and exclude future outcome/research runtime time.
binding.normalization: Aware timestamps normalized to UTC, source units retained, ordered role/id/version references with explicit native fingerprint scheme; exact aliases retained without conflicting collapse.

multi_horizon.future_extension: Separate versioned research design/approval required before any multi-observation approach; freeze all choices before outcomes and group same-origin events across splits.

conflicts.rule: Any required-source disagreement or missing/unverifiable authority prevents complete admission; no winner invented.
conflicts.precedence: Checks identify all applicable reasons in stable declared order; first code is reporting-only, never an override of another blocker.

maturity.unresolved_horizon: INADMISSIBLE_OR_UNRESOLVED; never a complete observation or guessed waiting duration
maturity.condition: R >= frozen end AND canonical exact session/phase completed with proof known_at <= R; outcome evidence must also be known by R.
maturity.session_complete_missing_bar: Completion is not a complete label; retain exclusion/null outcome.
maturity.OOS: Only eligible mature evidence enters predecessor frozen OOS methodology; no fitting or labels generated here.

historical_replay.new_version: Explicit immutable successor; old decisions preserve old versions.
historical_replay.administrative_replay: Retained later run metadata permitted only as predecessor administrative lineage, never as D-visible approval or features.
historical_replay.historical_feasibility: A policy approved after an original D cannot authorize a historical observation under the frozen protocol. No retrospective exception is introduced; prospective applicability or further governance is a genuine prerequisite.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: Exact strategy-specific research question and existing governed horizon definition if any
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: Separate planned comparison period from exit/expiry and business-fact observation. Establish relevance to both legs, not only the challenger.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: PIT-safe original setup/event cohorts and historical identities with calendar coverage
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: Original cutoff/features/version closure, non-survivor inclusion, revisions, conflicts and missingness accounted for. Bars alone are insufficient. This slice generates no cohort.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: Predeclared strategy-specific duration/counting hypotheses and independent test design
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: No retrospective best-return duration. Any candidate values/grid and reporting multiplicity need separate evidence justification and approval; none supplied here.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: Walk-forward/OOS evidence, maturity and overlap controls
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: Frozen train/validation/test separation, leakage/overlap treatment, held-out review and sensitivity/stability across relevant regimes; no sample, purge or embargo number invented.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: Paired economic relevance and uncertainty/missing-data audit
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: Same parcel/capital/horizon/method/INR; realized paired evidence and frictions separated. Single-leg win rate, self-improvement window or average holding duration is not sufficient.

numeric_evidence_requirements.evidence: Independent authorized policy review and exact approval/selection provenance
numeric_evidence_requirements.required: Record reviewer/authority/scope, evidence fingerprint and effective version. RA approval only where separately established as applicable; this proposal makes no new legal requirement. Approval is not performance proof.

readiness.evidence: Proposal identity/version and content scheme defined, not registered authority.
Research-only paired comparison; no implicit production or holding-period scope.
Closed roles, original D/source verification mandatory; no duration drivers from descriptive/future data.
Existing Watch/lead/strategy provenance reusable only with exact original event closure.

No numeric duration, range, average or grid supplied.
TRADING_SESSIONS is conceptual preference; effective unit remains null pending counting/terminal policy.
Future versioned table structure proposed; rows empty; HORIZON_MAPPING_POLICY_REQUIRED.
Inherited structural constraint: original D mandatory, selection inputs all D-visible.
Inherited start exactly D, not next session/fill/close.
Counting origin, phase, precision and security/closure exception rules unresolved.
Existing factual resolver is suitable supporting capability; not a general economic N-session counting policy.
One complete immutable resolution and fingerprint shared by both legs.
Exactly one selected category and bound horizon; no fan-out/grid authorized.
Reuse exact endpoint plus canonical completion/known-at proof; no labels generated.
Original event/lead/approval/mapping/calendar closure not proved for historical pairs.
Reject conflicting applicable source categories/versions; no arbitrary winner or fallback.
Future compatibility possible only with independent live governance/activation; no authority inherited.
No approval, effective time or registry registration created.
No new historical coverage capture; exact D-visible schedules/phases and instrument terminal evidence still required.
